r:
Forum posts are full of characters that mean something in Markdown. The renderer escapes the ones that would change the output, and only those. # not a heading #hashtag stays as it is - not a list item + not one either 1. not an ordered list 1) and not this > not a quote --- not a rule --- --- === 2 * 3 * 4 = 24, a_b_c, snake_case_name, *stars*, **more stars**, _underscores_, ~~tildes~~, `backticks` [a link](https://example.com) and ![an image](https://example.com/x.png) and [a reference][1]
HTML
, bold, , a < b > c, & © and | not | a | table | | --- | --- | --- | \ a backslash, C:\Users\alice, \*already escaped\* [b]BBCode that s9e left alone[/b], :smile: @alice #general [b]The elements still work[/b] in the middle of it: [i]2 * 3[/i], [url=https://example.com/a_b]a_b[/url].
